name: Japan's Designated Cities and Their Wards
description: The twenty designated cities (政令指定都市), each with a ward (区), written in full, without the prefecture, and the city alone. Every case is a city hall's address or a made-up block in a real town. Original case written for this corpuss; shapes follow Japan Post's guidance on writing an address (郵便番号・住所の書き方), described in our own words; nothing copied.
